name: expandable-table
title: Expandable table
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A row opens into a checklist, a nested total, or a tree of subtasks. Several rows can stay open. Arrow keys, selection, filters, density, and pages stay on the host table.

meta.descriptionEs: Una fila se abre en tareas, en partidas con total o en subtareas. Pueden quedar varias abiertas. Flechas, selección, filtros, densidad y páginas siguen en la tabla del anfitrión.

examples.title: Pedidos del taller
examples.description: PED-1048 se abre en tareas del horno, en partidas de $18,400.00 MXN o en subtareas.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, 320 px, RTL y diez filas.

api.name: rows / columns
api.description: Each row has an id. A column renders header and cell. rowTitle names the row for buttons.

api.name: renderDetail / getSubRows
api.description: A panel under the row, or child rows drawn with an L rail. Both can exist.

api.name: expanded / onExpandedChange
api.description: Which rows are open. Arrow right opens the focused chevron and arrow left closes it. Open all and close all use the same callback.

api.name: filters / searchText / actions
api.description: A select keeps rows that pass. Search keeps a parent when a child matches. The row menu calls onAction.

api.name: onSubtasksChange / density / pageSize
api.description: The subtask switch opens every nested row. Density and page size are host-controlled when the callbacks are set.

api.name: loading / error / labels
api.description: Skeleton, alert, and English chrome. ExpansionChecklist and ExpansionLines are the two panel formats.

docs: Clean-room reading of an expandable datatable. Shadcn Studio Pro was not purchased, fetched, or ported. No source, sample rows, icons, or assets were copied. The workshop orders are fictional. The piece uses useLegacyTable and getExpandedRowModel from @tanstack/react-table. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite badge, button, checkbox, dropdown-menu, input, select, skeleton, or switch. No theme, cssVars, or palette colors. The open animation is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion.
